meta.name: indexing
meta.description: How to read and query onchain data — events, The Graph, Dune, Ponder, Multicall3, and WebSocket subscriptions. Why you cannot loop through blocks and what to use instead.

copy.tagline: 学会高效读取链上数据，避开区块遍历
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想为应用读取并查询链上事件与数据。
copy.tagline_en: Learn to read and query onchain data without looping blocks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access onchain data for your application.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会知道怎么读取和查询链上数据,涵盖事件日志、The Graph、Dune 等,并会用替代方案来处理不能直接遍历区块的情况。
howto.when: 当你想查询链上数据、了解事件索引或问为什么不能遍历区块时,它会给出索引方法。

say.text: 怎么查某个合约的历史事件?
say.note: 它会给出用 The Graph 或 Dune 的步骤。

say.text: 我不想遍历区块,有什么替代方案?
say.note: 会推荐 Multicall3 和 WebSocket 订阅。

say.text: 用 Ponder 索引这个合约的数据
say.note: 它会讲解 Ponder 的配置方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will know how to read and query on-chain data, covering event logs, The Graph, Dune, and more. It will also use alternatives since you cannot loop through blocks.
howto.when_en: When you ask about querying on-chain data, indexing events, or why looping through blocks is not possible, it will provide indexing methods.

say_en.text: How do I query historical events for a contract?
say_en.note: It will give steps using The Graph or Dune.

say_en.text: I don't want to loop through blocks. What are alternatives?
say_en.note: It will recommend Multicall3 and WebSocket subscriptions.

say_en.text: Index this contract's data with Ponder
say_en.note: It will explain how to configure Ponder.
